children.name: Acteocina bullata
children.description: Acteocina bullata, common name the striate barrel bubble, is a species of small sea snail, a marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusk in the family Acteocinidae, the barrel bubble snails.

children.name: Acteocina fusiformis
children.description: Revised description. Shell small, solid, moderately slender, elongate ovate with slightly convex sides (SL / MD = 2.2 – 2.3). Protoconch of about 1.5 whorls, flattened, strongly tilted (~ 140 °), with nucleus two-thirds covered by first teleoconch whorl. Teleoconch of about three whorls separated by deeply canaliculated suture. Spire conical, weakly cyrtoconoid (apical angle 81 – 95 °), broad (MD / ApD = 1.5 – 1.6). Early teleoconch whorls weakly convex, nearly straight sided with periphery at abapical suture, rapidly increasing in height. Last whorl 90 – 93 % of total height, no shoulder, rounded at slowly contracting base. Periphery placed just above mid-whorl (SL / PH = 1.7 – 1.8). Surface glossy with delicate, shallowly arcuate growth lines. Aperture 80 – 83 % of total height, moderately narrow in upper half (MD / AW = 7.3 – 7.6), widening anteriorly (MD / MAW = 2.1 – 2.5), resulting in moderate expansion rate (ER = 3.0 – 3.5). Outer lip simple, thin, shallowly arcuate in profile, straight to slightly pinched inwards just below mid-whorl, rounded at base. Columella short, moderately to weakly excavated, thickened, forming narrow rim with prominent central columellar fold. Columellar callus delimiting narrow, shallow umbilical chink, persisting continuously into narrow, moderately thickened parietal callus. Paratethyan synonyms. Acteocina heraclitica Berger, 1949 is a subjective junior synonym of Acteocina fusiformis (Boettger, 1907).
